2026-10-31. Alternative representation after the global scan failed.

This derives the needed operation rather than treating a stochastic union
bound as a coherent norm bound. Inclusion-exclusion, Mobius inversion and
polymer counting are standard tools; historical novelty is not claimed.

1. Exact finite transfer

Use the finite circuit/Pauli-history receiver of COHERENT_ALTERNATIVE.txt.
Each actual supported noise map N_i is CPTP, F_i=N_i-Id, ||F_i||_diamond<=eta_i.
Let b(S) in {0,1} be a fixed conservative badness predicate on fault subsets;
when b(S)=0, the same decoder corrects every Pauli history on S. Assume
b(empty)=0. The finite circuit is multilinear in its noise slots.

Write Phi_S for the expansion term with F at exactly S and Id elsewhere.
The formal bad contribution is Psi_bad=sum_S b(S) Phi_S. Its complement is
Id_L tensor a linear bath map by the universal Pauli-history certificate.
The complete decoded Phi is CPTP, even though Psi_bad need not be CP.

Define the Boolean Mobius coefficients
 a(U)=sum_(V subset U) (-1)^(|U|-|V|) b(V).
Then b(S)=sum_(U subset S) a(U), and EXACTLY
 Psi_bad=sum_U a(U) Phi_[at least U].
In Phi_[at least U], F_i is forced at U and every other noise slot is the
unrestricted actual N_i. CPTP contractivity therefore gives
 ||Phi_[at least U]||_diamond<=product_(i in U) eta_i.
With the CP comparison projection P from COHERENT_ALTERNATIVE.txt, obtain
 inf_(Lambda_B CPTP) ||Phi-Id_L tensor Lambda_B||_diamond
 <=min(2, 2 sum_U |a(U)| product_(i in U) eta_i).             (M1)
Shared finite bath, arbitrary initial logical-bath-reference entanglement,
ideal correction Kraus records and all supports are retained. This is a
coherent fault-norm certificate; a(U) are signed coefficients, not probabilities.

2. A sufficient local structure with a size-uniform bound

Suppose the N fault slots form a graph of maximum degree D, and b(S)=1 iff
the induced graph on S has a connected component of at least k vertices.
This is an ADDITIONAL receiver structure to check; it is not inferred merely
from a small stochastic badness probability or from eroder stability.

If U has a connected component C with |C|<k, then b(V) for V subset U is
independent of every bit in C. The alternating sum over V intersect C
cancels, hence a(U)=0. Also |a(U)|<=2^|U|. Thus nonzero coefficients live

2026-10-31. Scientific conclusion, with the consequential objective retained.

Selected objective

Preserve an unknown qubit, including reference entanglement, for a lifetime
that grows with system size using local autonomous dynamics. The physical
destination remains low-dimensional hardware without a global correction
clock or decoder. This is a different family from thermodynamic inference.
OBJECTIVE.txt records the intended consequence and why a finite global-code
success would not meet it.

Existing machinery was tried first

Ordinary autonomous QEC already protects small codes. A five-qubit global
reset therefore is a validation receiver, not a new technology. Conventional
global-decoder bounds do not by themselves supply a constant local-rate
scalable architecture. The 2D synchronous QCA source provides a stronger
existence construction, but explicitly leaves its continuous-time threshold
extension for future proof. Its individual service-time estimate is not a
joint fault-locality certificate.

Astra N881 provides the needed new ingredient for a scalable 4D consequence:
one location-only event certifies EVERY supported Pauli history, one fixed
decoder, transient syndromes and accumulated homology. Its completed internal
reconstruction and named probability imports are retained. Its general
regularized noise extension changed the physical generator by adding floors.

The actual obstruction encountered here was different: a native quantum bath
can make fault times depend on its quantum state, and direct finite-rate CPTP
uniformization can fail for every rate. A small average jump rate does not
bound this process. Uncharged no-jump dynamics can create logical errors.

syndrome space. Then true good-record Kraus operators factor as identity on
the logical space, even though their probabilities depend on the bath.
